questions.stem: A 45-year-old man is brought to the emergency department after being found unconscious at home. He has a history of type 1 diabetes mellitus and reports recurrent episodes of hypoglycemia. His wife mentions that he has been trying a new "natural" supplement along with his prescribed insulin. On arrival, his blood glucose is 45 mg/dL. Laboratory tests reveal undetectable serum C-peptide levels. Which of the following is the most likely cause of his hypoglycemia?
